name: com.projecta0/watch
title: ProjectA0 Watch — Top 50 SaaS Subprocessor & AI-Clause Tracker
description: Track Top 50 B2B SaaS subprocessor lists, AI-training clauses, SHA-256 hashes & daily legal diffs.

tools.name: search_saas_vendors
tools.description: Search and filter ProjectA0 Watch's verified Top 50 B2B SaaS subprocessor & AI-clause compliance baseline (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR).

query.description: Optional keyword matching vendor name, category, compliance framework, or auditor note.

category.description: Optional exact category filter (e.g. Payments, DevTools, AI, Productivity, Cloud).

ai_clause_status.description: Optional AI/ML data-training clause status filter.

subprocessor_only.description: If true, return only vendors with a dedicated subprocessor list page.

limit.description: Maximum number of vendors to return (1-50, default 15).

tools.name: get_vendor_compliance
tools.description: Get the full verified compliance baseline, SHA-256 hash, AI-training clause status, official monitored URL, and recent diffs for a specific SaaS vendor slug (e.g. 'airtable', 'atlassian', 'circleci').

tools.name: list_recent_compliance_diffs
tools.description: List the latest verified SaaS subprocessor and AI-clause legal text diffs detected by ProjectA0 Watch's daily 06:00 UTC deterministic SHA-256 monitor.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent diffs to return (1-30, default 10).
